stem.text: A sample of a solution of sucrose tested for reducing sugars remains blue, but when another sample of the same solution is tested for non-reducing sugars the solution turns red.

A.text: During the non-reducing sugar test, an acid hydrolyses sucrose to glucose and fructose.

B.text: During the non-reducing sugar test, sucrose molecules condense into polysaccharides.

C.text: The reducing sugar test converts sucrose into glucose and fructose.

D.text: The reducing sugar test hydrolyses monosaccharides to disaccharides.
